data.text: Aggression in all forms toward its goal. Dimensions does not track weapon type; attack skills specify weapon uniqueness.

logic.description: Attack card (A). Needs the card in hand and an enemy in contact (or an empty tile, which makes it a one-hex movement intent without damage). Combat damage = 1 base + 1 vs Posture / Empty Posture (A>P), 0 vs Block (B>A: the attacker takes 1 from the blocker unless they hold Ranged Weapon), 1 vs Move. Cannot emit non-instant effects (Reaver excepted); instants ride on it. Rule 15 follow: an Attack may chase a moving target.

prerequisites.description: An Attack card is in the caster's hand.
The right-clicked target is in contact (distance <= 1).
The target is an enemy unit or an empty tile.

effects.description: Matrix damage of the Attack against the defender's action (A>P/EP 2, vs M 1, vs B 0).
Damage the attacker takes back from a blocking defender: 1, or 0 with Ranged Weapon.
Swinging into an empty tile steps one hex toward it; a unit target is not approached.
Attack does not emit (Rule 20), except the Reaver stance.

validation.description: Attack beats exactly Posture in the 4-cycle.
Attack loses exactly to Block in the 4-cycle.

data.text: No action card played; can still cast effects. Doesn't gain Posture's benefits. Can be converted to Empty Move (declared first). Always returns to hand after resolution.

logic.description: Empty Posture (EP): no card is played, so it is always available and returns nothing to the discard. It emits (casts advance) but has no bonus of its own: an attacking enemy reads it as Posture (takes 2), a posing enemy reads it as Move (takes 1), Move and Block neutralise it. Class stances rewrite it for the combat maths: Reaver -> A, Barbarian -> B, Monk -> M. Move and Posture skills ride on it. Sanctuary only protects while the declared action is EP.

prerequisites.description: No card is needed; EP can always be declared.

effects.description: Empty Posture emits.
The action combat is judged on after class stances: A / B / M for Reaver / Barbarian / Monk, else EP.
EP deals nothing by itself (matrix row 0).
What the defender's action scores on a plain EP (Attack 2, Posture 1, Move/Block 0).
No card leaves the hand.

validation.description: An empty action has no edges of its own.

data.text: Special way of playing Empty Posture; declared first; moves character halfway toward target tile.

logic.description: Empty Move (EM): a declared-first way of playing Empty Posture; always available, no card. The caster walks ceil(dist/2) hexes along the shortest path toward the target tile (min 1 when the target is not the own tile), at the lowest movement priority (A > M > EM at a shared destination). It still emits (Rule 20) and has no bonus: Block reads it as Move (takes 1), Posture reads it as Move (takes 1). Reaver: fights as an Attack.

prerequisites.description: No card is needed; EM can always be declared (before the flip).
A destination tile at distance >= 1 is chosen.

effects.description: Halfway toward the target: ceil(dist / 2), at least 1.
Empty Move emits like Empty Posture.
The action combat is judged on: A for a Reaver, else EM.
What the defender's action scores on a plain EM (Posture 1, Block 1 per the data edges, Attack 0).

validation.description: An empty action has no edges of its own.
Empty Move keeps targeting a tile.
